findings.violated_requirement_or_contradiction: REQ-006 and REQ-022/REQ-023 classify an onboarding companion's incorrect current status as an actual defect. The managed guide states that S08 through S14 are all remaining work, while the Report at the reviewed HEAD records S08 through S11 as closed and later asserts S12 closure.
findings.concrete_impact: The required onboarding companion presents an obsolete execution state, cannot satisfy AC-023/AC-024 at this HEAD, and can direct new members into already-closed milestones while obscuring the still-open Human, S13, and S14 gates.

findings.exact_location: src/spec_dock/assets/spec_dock/scripts/spec_dock_runtime/application/issue_planning.py, run_issue_planning_apply(), archive-candidate catch for IssuePlanningCandidateArchiveRejected; src/spec_dock/assets/spec_dock/scripts/spec_dock_runtime/application/ports.py, IssuePlanningCandidateArchiveRejected
findings.violated_requirement_or_contradiction: REQ-011 requires archive-validator findings to be retained in result details, and the accepted Blocker N boundary freezes existing status/reason/details mappings. IssuePlanningCandidateArchiveRejected stores its tuple in error.findings, but run_issue_planning_apply reads error.args[0] only when it is a tuple; error.args[0] is always the fixed string
findings.concrete_impact: Every apply-time Candidate archive rejection returns rejected/archive_rejected with empty details, discarding the concrete validation findings needed to identify the rejected archive class and establish auditable, safe follow-up evidence.

findings.violated_requirement_or_contradiction: REQ-009, REQ-012, AC-025, and Design §8.2 require symlink destinations to be rejected before mutation and prior state to be restored exactly. snapshot_regular_file() calls Path.exists() before its non-symlink check; Path.exists() follows symlinks, so a dangling symlink is classified as an absent file. The test covers only a symlink whose target exists.
findings.concrete_impact: An approved archive or git-bound apply can replace a dangling companion or decision-artifact symlink instead of rejecting it. If a pre-commit failure then triggers rollback, the recorded absent snapshot removes the replacement but does not restore the original symlink, violating both pre-mutation safety and exact rollback.

findings.exact_location: tests/unit/application/test_issue_planning.py import block and PLANNING_DEPENDENCIES construction; tests/unit/application/test_issue_planning_apply.py import block and PLANNING_DEPENDENCIES construction
findings.violated_requirement_or_contradiction: The accepted corrected Blocker N contract requires application unit-test fakes to conform to the application-owned IssuePlanningDependencies/IssuePlanningGateway boundary without depending on concrete infrastructure modules. These application unit tests instantiate _Clock and _IssuePlanningGateway from cli.bootstrap and import infra.contracts and infra.issue_planning_candidate types directly.
findings.concrete_impact: The application unit suite exercises the production composition adapter and concrete infrastructure DTOs rather than independently proving the application port. It can remain green while application-to-infrastructure coupling regresses, so the reported Blocker N boundary closure and its structural evidence are incomplete.

findings.violated_requirement_or_contradiction: REQ-014, AC-013, the Completion Boundary, and Plan §22 require a Human-approved new-boundary live create→fresh Review→exact Human decision→apply→ready/remote-parity run before S12 closes. The Report still records S07 as blocked at the Human gate and S12 as Human-gate pending, but later labels S12 closed. Its Final Quality Gate simultaneously records Final QA and Final Code Review as not started, Final Spec Review as failed against an obsolete HEAD, and Final Commit as blocked.
findings.concrete_impact: The full regression, distribution, parity, and prompt-tuning evidence cannot substitute for the required live Human-gated acceptance chain or exact-HEAD S14 reviews. S12 through S14 closure and merge-ready handoff are therefore not established.
